Inside the building, Beech Gardens is also renowned for its expansive garden space, which features a treehouse pavilion and common areas designed for students to rest and relax. The accommodation even offers all-inclusive bills, free WiFi, free parking, and free laundry services to help residents save a lot. On-site security measures include CCTV and secure fob entry, as well as a friendly on-site team. There are also free regular events, study and games areas, and more amenities.  Choose from self-contained studios for private living or 3- or 5-bedroom apartments for a community experience. You can choose to enjoy more privacy in the self-contained studios or share with friends in one of the 3 or 5-bed apartments. Studios: Each studio room at Beech Gardens Birmingham features a small double bed, a study space, and ample storage, as well as your own en-suite bathroom and kitchen equipped with an under-counter fridge, freezer, oven, and microwave.Non-en-suite rooms: You will have a private bedroom, a small double bed, a study space, and ample storage. The bathroom, social living space, and kitchen are shared, and each kitchen is fully equipped with a fridge-freezer, oven, and microwave. En-suites: Enjoy your private bedroom with your own bathroom, and achieve the perfect balance between affordability and privacy.
 Almero Student Beech Gardens is also popular for its expansive garden space and the addition of two brand-new treehouse pavilions, making it a perfect choice for relaxation and fun. There will be dedicated study rooms where you can achieve your academic goals. After that, you can head to the games room to relax and compete with friends. Additionally, the apartment features facilities such as bike storage, recycling, and renewable energy, making your everyday life more convenient. There will also be regular free events to help you meet your neighbors and make new friends. The rent at Beech Gardens Birmingham will be all-inclusive to cover your utilities. What's more, you will save a lot of money with free WiFi, free laundry (saving £ 6 per load), and 65 free parking spaces (saving £40/day). There will be no more deposits, but advance rent (2% of the total rent) has replaced deposits and will be deducted from your first rent instalment. When it comes to safety, CCTV and a secure fob entry system in the building will make your living hassle-free. A friendly on-site team to ensure you have someone to ask for help, and the on-site maintenance will handle all problems in your room in minutes. What's Nearby Almero Student Beech Gardens? Located in one of the most popular student hubs at Edgbaston, Beech Gardens is just a stone's throw from a variety of amenities designed to make life easier and more enjoyable for students. Famous market chains like Premier (7 min walk) and Co-op (8 min walk) are steps away, and Morrisons is also accessible with a 15-minute walk. A 5-minute bike ride will lead students to popular dining options, including McDonald's, Three Church Road Restaurant, Baloci, and The Blue Piano. 
 
As for nightlife, Birmingham is renowned for its diverse bars and vibrant live music scenes. The most popular Broad Street, home to various pubs and restaurants, is a walk of under 20 minutes or a bike ride for 5 minutes from the Beech Gardens accommodation. Nearest options include The High Field, The Brew Bar Lounge, and Gas Street Social. For live music, O2 Academy is also a 20-minute walk aside the city centre.
 
There are more things you can do near Beech Gardens Birmingham. Pure Gym is a 15-minute walk away and is open 24/7, perfect for those who want to work out. The Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery is a 17-minute bus ride away, featuring nine extraordinary venues with world-class museum collections. The Barber Institute of Fine Arts (18-minute bus) is a leading art gallery and concert hall within its Grade-1 listed building. For science enthusiasts, The Thinktank Science Museum (a 24-minute bus ride away) is a great place to spend the afternoon, featuring the 4K Planetarium and an interactive outdoor Science Garden. If you're looking for a place with natural beauty, Cannon Hill Park (30-minute bus) is perfect for a Sunday picnic.

With two main high streets, Selly Oak Shopping Park and the Student Oriented Harborne high street, filled with charming pubs and coffee shops, the area exudes a calm ambiance. Restaurants: Tasteology (7 min walk), Copper Fox Grill (7 min walk), John's Plaice in Harborne (8 min walk). Bars & Pubs: Bell Harborne (9 min walk), New Inn (17 min walk), O'Neill's Harborne (19 min walk).Supermarkets: Waitrose & Partners (19 min walk), Sainsbury's Local (24 min walk).Shopping: Selly Oak Shopping Park (20 min bus; 7 min cycle), Harbone High Street (15 min bus; 6 min cycle).Birmingham City Centre: 36 min bus. TransportFor students living at Duncan Smith House, transport options are varied and efficient, allowing you to easily travel to nearby universities. Bus Stop: 2-7 minute walk to Flats (55), Sedgehill Ave (55), Wheats Ave (55, 76, X22 Platinum).Train Station: University (12 min bus; 7 min cycle); Selly Oak (20 min bus; 9 min cycle).University of Birmingham: 15 min bus; 9 min cycle.Newman University: 20 min bus; 13 min cycle.Birmingham City University: City South campus (21 min bus); City Centre campus (45 min bus). Security & ServicesDuncan Smith House offers students a complete service and a secure living environment with double-glazed windows and doors, CCTV, security & fire alarms.  Your electric and water bills are all included in the rent so you have not to worry about any hidden costs.

name: Canvas The Old Fire Station
address: Aston Street, Birmingham B4 7DA, United Kingdom
about:
Canvas The Old Fire Station is an affordable student accommodation in Birmingham located in the heart of the city. Situated at Aston Street, B4 7DA, the accommodation is just a short walk from several top universities, including Aston University (11 min walk), Birmingham City University (8 min walk), and the University College Birmingham (20 min walk). Just a 5-minute walk from the City Centre, you will also enjoy easy access to the city's best amenities. Canvas The Old Fire Station is renovated from a historic Grade II listed fire station, where you will not only live in a hub of camaraderie but also be offered modern amenities like an on-site gym, free WiFi, study spaces, a games area, and a 24-hour team. Find your perfect home at the heart of this city, and enjoy the best of your student life at The Old Fire Station Birmingham! FeaturesCanvas The Old Fire Station provides a range of different room types designed to meet every requirement, including studios, en-suites, and non en-suites. Every room is furnished with a cosy bed for good sleep, a dedicated study space to concentrate, a wardrobe and ample storage for your belongings. With thoughtfully designed rooms and modern furnishings, The Old Fire Station offers a comfortable living environment while as one of the most affordable student accommodations in Birmingham. A short lease for 25 weeks is also available now.  Not only inside the room, The Old Fire Station Birmingham also offers plenty of communal amenities to create a supportive and welcoming community where students can relax, make new friends, and thrive.24-hour Team: Ready to offer a hand whenever you need it.Study Areas: Create a quiet and productive place to hit your goals.Games Area: Compete with flatmates and make new ones.Gym: Fully equipped with modern facilities to help you work out.Bills Included: All utility bills are covered in rent without hidden costs.Free WiFi: Superfast for you to surf online with no disruption.Laundry: Onsite laundry facilities to help you do the chores.
 Location and What's Hot? Canvas The Old Fire Station in Birmingham is situated just north of Birmingham City Centre, with a 5-minute walk. Everything you need will be found at the doorstep or just a short walk.Supermarket: Tesco Express is just across the road from Canvas The Old Fire Station.Restaurant: Wok&Go - Aston University, Rio's Piri Piri, and african restaurant are just downstairs.Bar & Pub: Sacks Of Potatoes, The Gosta Green, The Bull, Gunmakers Arms, and more are a walk for 5-7 minutes.Things to do: West Midlands Police Museum (6 min walk), Birmingham Science Garden (9 min walk), Thinktank Birmingham Science Museum (10 min walk), Eastside City Park (11 min walk), Redpoint Birmingham Climbing Centre (11 min walk) are popular places to go near The Old Fire Statio Birmingham.
 TransportCanvas The Old Fire Station is the perfect choice if you're looking for student accommodation near Aston University or Birmingham City University. Just walking for several minutes will get you to class and enable you to enjoy the same convenience as living on campus. If you want to explore the city, James Watt Queensway is the nearest bus stop right at your doorstep, and you can also take a 10-minute walk to Curzon Street Station or an 11-minute walk to St Chad's for the tram or trains. Birmingham Airport is also reachable with a short 19-minute car drive or a bus trip for 45-55 minutes.Aston University: 11 minutes on foot Birmingham City University: 8 minutes on foot University College Birmingham: 20 minutes on footUniversity of Birmingham: 25-35 minutes by bus Security & ServicesCanvas The Old Fire Station Birmingham prioritizes your safety and well-being with secure rooms, well-being support, and numerous resident events for you to get involved. Additionally, the 24-hour onsite team will be available to provide assistance at any time. All services and amenities, together with your utilities, are included in the rent, so there will be no more hidden costs to worry about.
